title: finding(components): `element:repeater` reads `properties.sort` into `$orderby` but its fetch effect does not list it as a dependency, so changing the sort does not re-read the rows
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site (class a). A changed sort is ignored until something else re-runs the fetch. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10623 dev report (PR objectui#10649, Acceptance notes). The round-1 contract review of that PR confirmed it at source. Read from the source, not measured. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site (read by the seat on objectui `origin/main`)

`packages/components/src/renderers/basic/data-list.tsx`, `RepeaterRenderer`:
- the fetch effect (~:120) sets `if (props.sort) query.$orderby = props.sort;` (~:132);
- its dependency list (~:155) is `[adapter, props.object, filterKey, props.limit]`, which has no `props.sort`.

PR objectui#10649 adds `invalidationNonce` to that list, and still not `props.sort`.

## Reach

Any host or designer that changes a repeater's `sort` on a mounted page, for example a bound sort control or a live designer preview, keeps showing the old order until the object, filter, limit or (after objectui#10623) a data-invalidation event re-runs the fetch.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Add a stable key for `props.sort` to the dependencies, the way `filterKey` stabilises the filter. Pin it: a sort change re-reads with the new `$orderby`, and a re-render with an equal sort does not re-read. ⛔ Serial: PR objectui#10649 edits this effect's dependency line, so claim this after it merges.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-24T00:00Z (740 items), titles matched against `repeater|\$orderby|sort.*dep`: the only hits are objectui#10239 (the SchemaForm repeater fallback, a different component) and objectui#10260 (kanban `$orderby`, merged). Lit control: the same walk finds objectui#10260 for `$orderby`.

Dedupe words: `element:repeater sort dependency` · `RepeaterRenderer orderby stale` · `data-list repeater sort not refetch`
